meta.name: ansoff-matrix
meta.description: Map evidence-backed growth options across the Ansoff Matrix with risk-rated sequencing. Use when the question is where the next tranche of growth comes from, and at what risk.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划增长策略并评估风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统分析增长机会并排序风险。
copy.tagline_en: Plan growth strategies and assess risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically analyze growth opportunities and sequence risks.

howto.what: 该技能产出一份基于证据的安索夫矩阵报告：在四个增长象限列出候选动作，逐个标注证据来源、风险评级与事实/推断/假设标签；最后给出按风险与资金逻辑排序的执行顺序，并写明会使该顺序失效的假设。
howto.when: 当你提出“下一阶段增长从哪里来、风险多大”，要求用安索夫矩阵梳理增长方案或把多元化方案拿证据检验时触发。

say.text: 用安索夫矩阵分析：核心是美国中小律所软件，目标两年增四成，不做并购。
say.note: 若缺少公司或产品背景，它会在开工前追问至多三个问题。

say.text: 我已有客户访谈和竞品资料，请据此填安索夫矩阵并给每项注明来源。
say.note: 现有资料会视为已回答，只搜索空缺的部分。

say.text: 董事会要看多元化方案，请把证据不足的多元化动作标成高风险或留空。
say.note: 空的多元化象限是合法结论，不会被硬凑。

howto.what_en: Outputs a researched Ansoff Matrix: four quadrants of growth options; each entry has a signal source, a risk rating, and a Fact/Inference/Assumption label. Ends with a sequence ordered by evidence and funding logic plus the assumption that would break it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask where the next tranche of growth is coming from and at what risk, request an Ansoff growth map, or ask to test a diversification narrative against signals.

say_en.text: Use Ansoff: core is US SMB legal software, +40% in 2 yrs, no M&A.
say_en.note: Missing inputs can prompt up to three clarifying questions.

say_en.text: Use my interview and competitor notes to fill each quadrant and cite sources.
say_en.note: Provided context counts as answers; only gaps get searched.

say_en.text: Board wants diversification; mark weak ideas high-risk or leave quadrant empty.
say_en.note: An empty quadrant is a valid result; don't pad it.
